description: Get the current Google News top stories (headlines) for a country and language, or the stories on a Google News topic page (pass its news.google.com/topics/... URL). Use this when the user asks what is in the news or for today's headlines. Free, no API key or credits.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the regional edition, e.g. "GB", "DE", "BR". Defaults to US.

language.description: Google News interface language, e.g. "en-GB", "de", "pt-BR". Defaults to en-US.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return. Defaults to 20.

topicUrl.description: A Google News topic or section URL, e.g. https://news.google.com/topics/CAAqJggKIiBDQkFTRWdvSUwyMHZNRGRqTVhZU0FtVnVHZ0pWVXlnQVAB. Omit for the front page.

name: top_stories
title: Google News top stories
